<h2 id="1.-Algal-pond-time-series-%E2%80%94-Exp039-(Cahill-proxy)">1. Algal pond time-series — Exp039 (Cahill proxy)<a class="anchor-link" href="#1.-Algal-pond-time-series-%E2%80%94-Exp039-(Cahill-proxy)">¶</a></h2><p>Simulate longitudinal <strong>relative-abundance–like</strong> pseudocounts for <strong>60</strong> pond days (<strong>15</strong> synthetic taxa), <strong>seed = 42</strong>, with an engineered <strong>crash</strong> at <strong>t = 40</strong> (half suppressed, half boosted). Computes <strong>Shannon</strong> (H) per timepoint and <strong>Bray–Curtis</strong> dissimilarity between consecutive samples.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Full Exp039 reproducibility uses <strong><code>n_taxa=20</code></strong> in <code>scripts/algae_timeseries_baseline.py</code>; the pedagogical slice below follows the <strong>15-taxa</strong> spec for this notebook while Rust parity reads the canonical frozen artifact.</p>
</blockquote>
